name: eess-monorepo
description: eess — architecture guardrails for AI coding agents. Monorepo root.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @nielspeter/eess && npm run build -w @nielspeter/eess-ts -w @nielspeter/eess-md -w @nielspeter/eess-mermaid -w @nielspeter/eess-gherkin && npm run build -w @nielspeter/eess-crossvalidate
scripts.validate: npm run build && npm run check:release && npm run check:integrity && npm run check:arch && npm run check:family && npm run check:baseline && npm run check:diagram && npm run check:crossval && npm run check:corpus && npm run check:ledger && npm run check:spec && npm run check:numbers && npm run check:vacuity && npm run check:nonvacuity && npm run typecheck && npm run check:examples && npm run check:docs-code && npm run check:review-harness && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run check:surface
scripts.check:fast: npm run check:release && npm run check:corpus && npm run check:spec && npm run check:arch && npm run check:family
scripts.fix: npm run lint:fix && npm run format

author: Niels Peter
//overrides: jsonschema is pinned to 1.5.0 to match patches/jsonschema+1.5.0.patch (Node-26 langium fix, bug 0083). Bump the pin and re-diff the patch together — otherwise postinstall's patch-package hard-fails on a context mismatch.
